description: This file contains classes related to generating and managing event data for Azure Event Hubs streams within the Orleans framework. It defines data generator classes for creating event data for specific streams and partitions, including infrastructure for logging and controlling stream data production.

classes.name: SimpleStreamEventDataGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating event data for a specific stream, including creating EventData instances and logging their creation.

classes.name: EventHubPartitionDataGenerator
classes.description: A class that manages multiple stream data generators within a single Event Hub partition, including adding, stopping, and reading events from streams.

methods.name: TryReadEvents
methods.description: Attempts to generate a batch of event data up to a maximum count, returning false if production is disabled.

methods.name: CreateFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory function for instantiating SimpleStreamEventDataGenerator objects for a given stream ID.

methods.name: AddDataGeneratorForStream
methods.description: Adds a new stream data generator for a specified stream ID.

methods.name: StopProducingOnStream
methods.description: Stops data production for a specified stream.
